name: Basic Master Agent
description: A basic master agent template for orchestrating tasks and coordinating workers. Provides task routing, worker management, and basic coordination capabilities.
author: commit-relay

capabilities.name: Task Routing
capabilities.description: Route tasks to appropriate workers based on capabilities

capabilities.name: Worker Coordination
capabilities.description: Coordinate multiple workers for complex tasks

scaffold.script_template:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# {{agent_name}} - {{description}}
# Generated from basic-master template
#

set -euo pipefail

readonly SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
readonly PROJECT_ROOT="$(cd "$SCRIPT_DIR/../../.." && pwd)"

# Source libraries
source "$PROJECT_ROOT/scripts/lib/agentstudio/agent-register.sh"

# Agent configuration
readonly AGENT_NAME="{{agent_name}}"
readonly AGENT_CLASS="{{agent_class}}"

#
# Initialize agent
#
init_agent() {
    # Register with agent registry
    local capabilities='{{capabilities_json}}'
    
    AGENT_ID=$(register_agent \
        "$AGENT_CLASS" \
        "$AGENT_NAME" \
        "1.0.0" \
        "$capabilities" \
        "{{description}}")
    
    echo "Agent registered: $AGENT_ID"
}

#
# Main agent loop
#
run_agent() {
    echo "Starting $AGENT_NAME..."
    
    init_agent
    
    # Main loop
    while true; do
        # Send heartbeat
        agent_heartbeat "$AGENT_ID"
        
        # TODO: Implement task routing logic
        # TODO: Implement worker coordination logic
        
        sleep {{heartbeat_interval:-60}}
    done
}

# Run if executed directly
if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "${0}" ]]; then
    run_agent
fi

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Description of the master agent's purpose

parameters.name: confidence_threshold
parameters.description: Minimum confidence threshold for routing decisions
